label: MRtrix3 sh2response
description:
Generate an appropriate response function from the image data for spherical deconvolution
The spherical harmonic coefficients are stored according the conventions described the main documentation, which can be found at the following link: 
https://mrtrix.readthedocs.io/en/3.0.8/concepts/spherical_harmonics.html

parameters.label: lmax
parameters.description: specify the maximum harmonic degree of the response function to estimate
parameters.usage: 使用原始命令参数；未指定的可选参数不传给软件。
parameters.software_default: 参见本机安装版本原始帮助。

parameters.label: 生成 dump
parameters.description: dump the m=0 SH coefficients from all voxels in the mask to the output file, rather than their mean

parameters.label: quiet
parameters.description: do not display information messages or progress status; alternatively, this can be achieved by setting the MRTRIX_QUIET environment variable to a non-empty string.

parameters.label: nthreads
parameters.description: use this number of threads in multi-threaded applications (set to 0 to disable multi-threading).
parameters.usage: 使用原始命令参数；未指定的可选参数不传给软件。

input_slots.label: SH
input_slots.description: the spherical harmonic decomposition of the diffusion-weighted images

input_slots.label: mask
input_slots.description: the mask containing the voxels from which to estimate the response function

input_slots.label: directions
input_slots.description: a 4D image containing the direction vectors along which to estimate the response function

output_slots.label: response
output_slots.description: the output axially-symmetric spherical harmonic coefficients

output_slots.label: dump
output_slots.description: dump the m=0 SH coefficients from all voxels in the mask to the output file, rather than their mean This generic file port does not establish a specialized scientific artifact type; downstream use must match the documented contents, not merely the filename extension.
